subject: general
question: ______ an initiative by the Ministry of Culture, Government of India, being executed by Lalit Kala Akademi and National Gallery of Modern Art, in July 2024.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Project PARI**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Project PARI** is an initiative by the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.
 
• It is being executed by **Lalit Kala Akademi** and the **National Gallery of Modern Art**.
 
• The project is set to commence in **July 2024**.
 
• PARI stands for **Project for Art and Regional Integration**, focusing on promoting regional art forms.
 
• The initiative aims to **preserve and promote India's rich cultural heritage** and diverse art forms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lalit Kala Akademi**

 
 
• Established in 1954, it is the National Academy of Art under the Ministry of Culture.
 
• It aims to promote and propagate understanding of Indian art, both within and outside the country.
 
• It organizes various national and international exhibitions, art camps, and workshops.
 
 
 
• **National Gallery of Modern Art (NGMA)**
 
 
• Founded in 1954, NGMA is a premier institution for modern and contemporary Indian art.
 
• It houses a vast collection of paintings, sculptures, and other works of art from prominent Indian artists.
 
• NGMA organizes exhibitions, educational programs, and workshops to promote art awareness.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Culture, Government of India**
 
 
• The ministry is responsible for the preservation and promotion of Indian cultural heritage.
 
• It oversees various cultural institutions, festivals, and initiatives across the country.
 
• It aims to foster cultural integration and appreciation among the diverse population of India.
 
 
 
• **Art and Regional Integration**
 
 
• Focuses on promoting regional art forms and cultural practices across India.
 
• Aims to create a platform for artists from different regions to showcase their talent.
 
• Encourages cultural exchange and appreciation among various communities and states.
